primary_source_trace.source_title: Calendario de los indios de Guatemala, 1722, Kiché
primary_source_trace.transmission: 18th-century original not directly available; Karl Hermann Berendt 1877 manuscript copy preserved
primary_source_trace.holding: University of Pennsylvania Library, Berendt-Brinton Linguistic Collection, Ms. Coll. 700 Item 58
primary_source_trace.facsimile_status: Digitized scans located/catalogue verified, original K'iche' day-and-month lines not independently transcribed by this worker
primary_source_trace.reported_content: Chol Bal K'ih and Ahi'l Bal K'ih; Julian/Gregorian European day equivalents recorded in later Berendt copy; dates also for 1723-1727

scholarly_reading.title: Maya Daykeeping: Three Calendars from Highland Guatemala
scholarly_reading.source_1722_chapter: Calendario de los indios de Guatemala, 1722 (pp. 64-135); original work currently catalogued, not fully read in this session
scholarly_reading.description: Contains K'iche'/Kaqchikel originals and facing translations for 1685, 1722 and 1854-55 calendars, plus correlation appendix; not among owner's four previously verified Maya books
scholarly_reading.priority_change: Higher immediate priority than Bricker's specialized astronomical volume FOR highland birth-day/time source policy, but not an absolute prerequisite to a small carefully limited human test
scholarly_reading.source_independence: Authors describe/publish copies of same 1722 manuscript; not independent repeated modern daykeeping observations.

first_civil_date_anchor.natal_or_electional: K'iche' ritual yearbearer, NOT personal birth trait
first_civil_date_anchor.source_report_historical_highland_year_s: 1 Nab'e Mam / First Elder (per scholarly Edmonson report; terminology must remain original source)
first_civil_date_anchor.source_sign_and_solar_pair_independence: 2016 publication already calculates calendar dates with GMT584283; agreement confirms consistency, not an independent arbitrary-calendar accuracy test
first_civil_date_anchor.origin: 2016 government work printed p.33 / PDF p.37 (one-based), citing manuscript; Edmonson secondary account supplies 9 Deer 1 First Elder Sunday May3 1722.

later_interpretive_source.title: Armonización de los calendarios mayas
later_interpretive_source.publisher: Guatemala Ministry of Culture and Sports
later_interpretive_source.warning: Authors explicitly use GMT 584283 to compute European calendar correspondence; nine matching source-table entries are source/engine reconstruction parity, not nine independent prospective confirmations.

critical_distinctions: 1722 archive transcription and 2009 scholarly edition are the same manuscript-lineage, not independent trials.
2016 historical yearbearer table source dates are author-selected and GMT-correlated, so re-running GMT 584283 mostly shows internal consistency, not independent secular calendar verification.
1 Nab'e Mam historical label, Highland New Year ceremony and Lowland 0 Pop month are NOT to be collapsed into one named day without community-specific reckoning.
1722 yearbearer date is historical collective/religious calendar, not evidence that natal traits exist.
Community-specific yearbearer signs and before/after-sunset ritual time remain separate from date-only Long Count arithmetic.
